title: Defense & Aerospace Report Podcast [Mar 23, 2020 Monday Business Report]
description: On this episode of the Business Podcast, sponsored by Bell, our guests include “Rocket Ron” Epstein, PhD, of Bank of America Merrill Lynch, Richard Aboulafia of the Teal Group consultancy and Sash Tusa of Agency Partners; Keith Flail, the vice president for advanced vertical lift systems at Bell; Ken Peterman, president, ViaSat Government Systems. Topics: — Analysis of the worst week on world markets since the 2008 financial collapse in the wake of the growing coronavirus pandemic — Whether an additional $1.7 trillion in fiscal measures by the US Congress — in addition to $2.4 trillion already implemented by the Federal Reserve — will calm markets — Rational for government intervention to support private industry — Update on Airbus and Boeing after a tough week on — Bell's Keith Flail on what's next for the company's V-280 Valor tiltrotor in the wake of the US Army's downselect decision on the Future Long-Range Assault Aircraft program — ViaSat Government Systems President Ken Peterman
